written_by: development agent from the five catalog photos, before the first measured run; evaluator-only input (the author receives the request notes only); the front photo is very small (194 px wide)
identity_features: Single wrap-around shield lens with a tall, straight-topped profile, spanning the whole front, with an angled cut at the centre bottom for the nose and a slight upward kick at the outer lower corners
Half-rim brow: a flat, matte dark navy bar along the top edge of the lens, no lower rim; the brow is thicker at the temples and thin over the centre
Lens finish: blue mirror coating, reflective sky-blue to violet, with a small 'invu' wordmark printed near the upper outer corner
Straight, flat temples, matte dark navy, with a lighter blue accent panel on the outer face along the middle of the temple
A small nose piece under the brow centre with dark pads; the brow does not descend around the lens
Wrapped front: in the side views the lens curves back toward the temples
Colour: matte dark navy (near-black with a blue cast) frame; no gloss

conditions.photos: front (194 px, low resolution), back, left, right and one three-quarter angled view (held out from the author)
